Short title and commencement

ACT XXI OF 1992
ACT XXI OF 1992
ANTIQUITIES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Antiquities Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 16th September, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 14th
September, 1992 and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Antiquities (Amendment) Act,
1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

General Amendment of Act VII of 1976

ACT XXI OF 1992
ACT XXI OF 1992

(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992

amend the Antiquities Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 16th September, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 14th
September, 1992 and is hereby published for general information:--
2. General Amendment of Act
VII of 1976:-----In the Antiquities Act, 1975 (VII of 1976), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, for the word "Director", wherever
occurring the word "Director-General" shall be substituted.

Amendment of section 2, Act VII of 1976

ACT XXI OF 1992

(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992

[Gazette of

The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 14th
September, 1992 and is hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 2, Act
VII of 1976.--In the said Act, in section 2, for clause (b) the following
shall be substituted, namely:--
"(b) `ancient', in relation
to an antiquity, means an antiquity which has been in existence for a period of
not less than seventy-five years;".

Amendment of section 3, Act VII of 1976

4. Amendment of section 3, Act
VII of 1976:---In the said Act, in section 3, for subsection (I), the
following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(1) For the purposes of
this Act, the Federal Government shall, by notification in the Official
Gazette, constitute an Advisory Committee comprising of such members, including
one member each from the Senate and the National Assembly, as may be deemed
necessary. The Chairman of the Advisory Committee shall be the member of
Parliament:".

Amendment of section 5A, Act VII of 1976

[Gazette of

The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 14th
September, 1992 and is hereby published for general information:--
5. Amendment of section 5A,
Act VII of 1976.--In the said Act, in section 5A, for subsection (3) the
following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(3) Where the
Director-General decides to take over an antiquity he may pay to the person by
whom it is handed over to him such cash reward as the Advisory Committee may
deem fit.".

Insertion of new section 13A, Act VII of 1976

ACT XXI OF 1992
ACT XXI OF 1992
ANTIQUITIES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Antiquities Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 16th September, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 14th
September, 1992 and is hereby published for general information:--
6. Insertion of new section
13A, Act VII of 1976:-----In this Act, after section 13, the following new
section shall be inserted, namely:--
"13A. Ownership of buried
antiquities.--Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the
time being in force, the ownership of all buried antiquities shall vest in the
Federal Government.".

Substitution of section 33, Act VII of 1976

The following Act of

September, 1992 and is hereby published for general information:--
7. Substitution of section 33,
Act VII of 1976.--In the said Act, for section 33, the following shall be
substituted, namely:--
"33.
Jurisdiction to try offences.---No Court inferior to that of Magistrate of
the first class shall take cognizance of or try an offence punishable under
this Act."
